resources.string: Limit the number of agent rounds per run. Applies to new runs on this device; running tasks keep their current limit. Paused tasks can be continued. This is not a money limit: retries and tools may incur additional usage.
Retry %1$d · waiting %2$d s. Retrying may incur additional usage.
Round %1$d of %2$d. The task will pause at the limit; you can continue it.
